name: Abuse Detection Cron

on:
  schedule:
    # Run every day at 00:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      duration:
        description: 'Duration to scan (e.g., 24h, 7d)'
        required: false
        default: '24h'
      parallel:
        description: 'Number of parallel workers'
        required: false
        default: '3'
      auto_apply:
        description: 'Automatically apply blocks'
        required: false
        default: 'true'

permissions:
  contents: write
  issues: write

jobs:
  detect-abuse:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Abuse Detection
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.DATABASE_URL }}
          # Add any other required environment variables for the script
        run: |
          npx tsx scripts/detect-abuse.ts \
            --last ${{ github.event.inputs.duration || '24h' }} \
            --parallel ${{ github.event.inputs.parallel || '3' }} \
            --auto-apply ${{ github.event.inputs.auto_apply || 'true' }}

      - name: Commit and Push Changes
        if: success()
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          author_name: "GitHub Actions Bot"
          author_email: "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          message: "chore: update abuse detection results"
          add: "scripts/abuse-detection-results.json" # Adjust path if the script outputs a specific file
          push: true
